name: rux
description: Syntax highlighting, completions, tag auto-closing, formatting and diagnostics for the Rux UI language (.rux files).

rux.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `rux` binary, which provides formatting and diagnostics. Install it with `cargo install ruxlang`. Leave as `rux` to find it on your PATH.

rux.check.enable.markdownDescription: Report problems from `rux check` as you open and save `.rux` files.

rux.autoClosingTags.markdownDescription: Write the closing tag when you finish an opening one, and complete `</`. Void elements (`<image>`, `<input>`) are never given a closing tag.
